:::{#me}
I am a M.S. in Integrative Biology student at the Univeristy of New Hampshire, in Dr. Ashley Bulseco's Coastal Microbial Ecology lab. My research focuses on the microbial and biogeochemical response to thin layer placement salt marsh restoration, with an emphasis on nitrogen cycling. I am also working on a project characterizing oyster microbiomes in oysters across a range of management and environmental conditions in Great Bay, NH. 

## Education
BS, Environmental Sciences, North Carolina State University, Minor in Soil Science

AS, Durham Technical Community College

:::
